desc.zh: 手算“第二件”时写下的位置，就是 ROW_NUMBER 的编号；再从 Users 出发 LEFT JOIN，让没有第二件的人也留下。
desc.en: The positions you write when finding “the second sale” by hand are ROW_NUMBER; a LEFT JOIN from Users keeps people who have no second sale.

complexity: O(m log m) time for the per-seller window sort; O(m) intermediate rows

concepts.name: Per-seller ranking
concepts.description: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY order_date) turns “second sale” into sale_rank = 2.

concepts.name: Preserving missing matches
concepts.description: Start from Users with a LEFT JOIN and put sale_rank = 2 in ON, so users without a second sale stay as no.
